generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

network.title: Connection problem
network.description: Atlas could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: The request took too long
timeout.description: The server did not respond in time. Please try again.

cancelled.title: Request cancelled
cancelled.description: The request was stopped before it completed.

validation.title: Check the highlighted fields
validation.description: Some information needs to be corrected before saving.

unauthorized.title: Your session has expired
unauthorized.description: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.description: Your account does not have permission to view this page. Contact your administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

conflict.title: This item was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.description: Please wait a moment before trying again.

server.title: Server error
server.description: Something failed on our side. We are looking into it — please try again shortly.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.description: An unexpected problem occurred. Please try again.

boundary.title: This section could not be displayed
boundary.description: The rest of Atlas is still working. Try reloading this section.
